ginally by intent, model and host.\n- [Get one run's suite quality-gate report](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/ge
t-one-runs-suite-quality-gate-report.md): ONE run's stored suite quality-gate report (`SuiteGateReportV1`): passed, failed, non_ga
teable, or not_configured.\n- [Enable, repoint, or disable a suite's schedule](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/ena
ble-repoint-or-disable-a-suites-schedule.md): A schedule fires exactly ONE run per interval, so an environment-based suite must pi
n exactly one of its attached environments. Omitting `environmentId` on a single-environment suite means that environment; omittin
g it on a multi-environment suite is a VALIDATION_ERROR. Disabling preserves the exist…\n- [Launch one run per target as a group (
async)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/launch-one-run-per-target-as-a-group-async.md): Launches ONE run per targe
t — attached project environments, or attached named hosts — under a single **server-minted** `runGroupId`, then detaches executio
n and responds `202` with a per-target receipt.\n- [Create an eval suite (author-only, does not run)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-
reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-suite-author-only-does-not-run.md): Creates a runnable eval suite — the suite record plus its t
est cases — and responds `201` **synchronously**, WITHOUT executing anything. Use this to author a suite, then run it later with `
POST /eval-runs` (passing the returned `suiteId`).\n- [Resolve or create a file-owned eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refe
rence/eval-runs/resolve-or-create-a-file-owned-eval-suite.md): Resolve a file-owned suite by declared id within the project, or cr
eate one. Lookup is by `(projectId, declaredSuiteId)` and never by name. A UI-authored suite has no declared id and cannot be clai
med. The inspector parses the suite file; this body is the declared identity, source hash, optional pro…\n- [Get one eval suite's
configuration](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-suites-configuration.md): The suite's full settings —
attached environments, hosts, execution config, judge, schedule. The list route returns run rollups instead; this is the shape the
edit routes read and write.\n- [Delete an eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-suite.md): D
eletes the suite and its cases. Past runs are not deleted.\n- [Update an eval suite's settings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refere
nce/eval-runs/update-an-eval-suites-settings.md): Partial update — omitted fields are left as they are. `environmentIds` is tri-st
ate: a non-empty array sets/replaces, `null` clears (reverting the suite to legacy config), and `[]` is rejected rather than silen
tly treated as a clear. Responds with the full updated suite.\n- [Get the pre-run disclosure for a suite launch plan](https://docs
.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-the-pre-run-disclosure-for-a-suite-launch-plan.md): What happens to a run's content BEFORE
you launch it: which models it calls and where they route, which LLM analyzers/judges can fire and where their evidence goes, cap
ture/retention/region facts, and the subprocessors engaged. Read-only — never launches or gates a run. Keyed by the SAME destinati
on…\n- [List a suite's eval cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-eval-cases.md): Every case in the
suite, in the public steps-first shape.\n- [Create an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-c
ase.md): Adds one case to the suite. Both `title` and a non-empty `steps` array are required — `steps` is optional on the shared c
ase shape so PATCH can be partial, but a case persisted without executable steps could never run. When `models` is omitted the sui
te's configured model is used.\n- [Create several eval cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-several-eval-
cases.md): Adds up to 100 cases to the suite in one call — the bulk form of the single create, and the way to import a suite or co
nvert a repo's test files without a round trip per case. Every entry needs a `title` and a non-empty `steps` array. Cases are vali
dated together and reported individually: a `failed…\n- [Generate eval cases from the suite's tools](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-r
eference/eval-runs/generate-eval-cases-from-the-suites-tools.md): Discovers the suite's server tools over a live MCP connection, g
enerates cases against them, and persists them — the only edit route that connects to a server. Synchronous: connect, generate, pe
rsist, disconnect, respond.\n- [Author eval cases from a document](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/author-eval-cas
es-from-a-document.md): The sibling of `cases/generate`: generation invents cases from the suite's tools, import reads them out of
something a person already wrote — a test plan, a spreadsheet of scenarios, a JSON export. MCPJam's own model turns the document
into full cases (ordered steps, tool calls, assertions), so the…\n- [Read an eval authoring job](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refer
ence/eval-runs/read-an-eval-authoring-job.md): Progress and drafts for a job started by `cases/generate` or `cases/import`. Poll t
his after a `202`, then commit the job once its `status` is `completed`.\n- [Write a finished authoring job's cases into the suite
](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/write-a-finished-authoring-jobs-cases-into-the-suite.md): Writes the job's draft
s into the suite. A draft carrying unresolved blocking issues or proposed additions is **skipped** rather than written, and comes
back under `skipped` with a `reviewUrl` for finishing it in the app.\n- [Get one eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/
eval-runs/get-one-eval-case.md): A case that belongs to this suite and project. A case in another suite is a 404, not a 403.\n- [D
elete an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-case.md): Removes the case from the suite. Past
runs that executed it are not affected.\n- [Update an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-c
ase.md): Partial update — omitted fields are left as they are. Supplying `steps` REPLACES the case's definition rather than mergin
g into it. `matchOptions` and `checks` accept `null` to clear the case-level override and fall back to the suite's.\n- [Upload a r
un artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/upload-a-run-artifact.md): Stores one artifact referenced by an inges
ted run (typically widget HTML too large to send inline) and returns the `storageId` the run's results then reference. This is wha
t `reportEvalResults` in `@mcpjam/sdk` uses for widget evidence.\n- [Get an upload URL for a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com
/api-reference/eval-runs/get-an-upload-url-for-a-run-artifact.md): Retired. Every request answers `410 Gone` with `code: \"FEATURE
_NOT_SUPPORTED\"` and `details.code: \"SDK_UPGRADE_REQUIRED\"`. `@mcpjam/sdk` 8.17.0 and later upload a run artifact by sending it
s bytes to `POST /projects/{projectId}/eval-ingest/artifacts`, which returns the `storageId` the run's results…\n- [Discover authe
nticated eval ingestion capabilities](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/discover-authenticated-eval-ingestion-capabi
lities.md): Discover authenticated eval ingestion capabilities. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the same tenant/project autho
rization as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabilities remain absent.\n- [Persist advisory case-run evaluations](https://docs.mcpjam
.com/api-reference/eval-runs/persist-advisory-case-run-evaluations.md): Persist advisory case-run evaluations. Uses the SDK report
ing transport and the same tenant/project authorization as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabilities remain absent.\n- [Ingest a co
mpleted eval run in one call](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/ingest-a-completed-eval-run-in-one-call.md): The who
le-run variant: submit a finished run and its iterations in a single request. This is what the SDK reporter uses by default.\n- [M
int a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-hoste
d-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) uses MCPJam-hosted inference on the organization's c
redits, with no provider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically an `sk_` key).\n- [Revoke a model
